learning_outcomes.text: Acquaint the students with the induction and synchronous machines arrangement, principle action, theory, characteristics and research methods.

syllabus_topics: General issues of the alternative current machines theory: windings, electromotive force, magnetomotive force, magnetic fields and inductive reactance of the alternative current windings.
Induction machines arrangement and principle action.
Synchronous machine arrangement and principle action.
assessment_rules: The exam is conducted in written form and consists of three subject questions. The final examination mark depends on the mark received on the laboratory exercises and course work that is submitted before beginning of the examination session.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Electrical Power Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS FEEA (datos antiguos; ver notas)
